annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that a peer must not initiate a stream with a stream ID higher than the maximum stream ID value it has received from the peer. The phrase “greatest maximum stream ID” refers to the highest value among the MAX_STREAM_ID frames that increased the limit, and there is no alternative interpretation that materially changes implementation behavior.
